rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase for RSO Units (2025-2026)
rules.requirement: The annual allowable rent increase for rental units subject to the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance is set at 3% for the period from July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026. Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
coverage.unresolvable: Applies only to RSO units, which require database verification via ZIMAS or LAHD.

rules.exemptions: Non-RSO properties are exempt from this specific limit and are subject to separate guidelines.
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
